app.name: NaqdPOS
app.tagline: Point of sale that works offline

errors.offline: No internet connection. Connect and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to sign in. Once signed in, the app works offline.
signIn.invalidCode: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
signIn.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
signIn.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
signIn.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not finish. Try again, or use your email.
signIn.unsyncedOther: This device has changes not yet synced. Sign in as {{email}} to sync them first.
signIn.unsyncedOtherUnknown: This device has changes not yet synced. Sign in with the previous account to sync them first.
signIn.otherShop: This device belongs to {{shop}}. Sign in with an account of that shop.
signIn.notOwner: Only the shop owner can sign in on this device

onboarding.title: Set up your shop
onboarding.intro: A few details and you can start selling.
onboarding.invalidMobile: Enter a Pakistani mobile number, e.g. 0300 1234567.
onboarding.pinHint: You will use this PIN to open the till and approve actions.
onboarding.invalidPin: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits.
onboarding.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.

device.name: Name for this device
device.nameHint: So you can tell your phones and computers apart.
device.registerIntro: You are signed in to {{shop}}. Add this device to use it in the shop.
device.modeOwnerHint: Gets everything, including salaries and cost prices.
device.modeShopHint: Staff switch with their PIN. Owner-only data never comes to this device.

setup.notOwner: Only the shop owner can set up a new device. Ask the owner to sign in here.

sync.title: Sync
sync.offline: You are offline. Sales are saved on this device and sync when you are back online.
sync.deviceUnlinked: This device is no longer linked to the shop
sync.clockAhead: Phone date/time is wrong — fix it and tap Sync now
sync.rejectedIntro: The server did not accept these changes. They are kept on this device.

error.forbidden: Not allowed for this user or device.
error.unknown_table: The server does not support this from this app version.
error.not_pushable: The server does not support this from this app version.
error.generic: The server did not accept this change.

reason.sales_reminder: Many sales are not synced yet. Connect to the internet and tap Sync now.
reason.age_2h: Some changes have not synced for over 2 hours.
reason.age_12h: Some changes have not synced for over 12 hours.
reason.age_24h: Some changes have not synced for over a day. Connect to the internet now.
reason.sales_100: More than 100 sales are not synced.
reason.storage_not_persisted: This browser may delete unsynced data. Install the app to keep it safe.
reason.storage_95: Device storage is full. Sync now and free up space.
reason.device_unlinked: This device is no longer linked to the shop
reason.rejected_entries: Some changes were not accepted. See below.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.pinHint: They use this PIN to switch in on the shop device.
staff.pinKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current PIN.
staff.inactiveNotice: This person is deactivated and cannot switch in.

errors.lastOwner: The shop needs at least one active owner.

pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
pin.nobody: Nobody can switch in yet. The owner adds staff and PINs under Settings → Staff.
pin.ownerIntro: Only the owner can open this screen.
pin.lockedMinutes: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{minutes}} min.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutIntro: Shop data stays on this device. Signing in again needs an account of this shop.
settings.signOutBlocked_one: {{count}} change is not synced yet. Sync before signing out.
settings.signOutBlocked_other: {{count}} changes are not synced yet. Sync before signing out.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products yet. Add one, or pick from the ready-made list.
products.hiddenNotice: This product is hidden and not shown for sale.
products.name: Name (English)
products.salePriceHint: Price per {{unit}}. 0 = ask for the rate at the first sale.
products.costElsewhere: Cost prices are set on an owner device (the owner’s own phone).
products.searchTermsHint: Comma separated, e.g. aloo, aalu. Helps the counter find it.

presets.title: Pick your products
presets.intro: Tick what you sell. Today’s rate is optional; without it the rate is asked at the first sale.
presets.rateError: Check the rates marked in red.

rates.title: Today’s rates
rates.introOwner: Sale price and cost per unit. Save all at once.
rates.error: Check the prices marked in red.
